messages:
jordan_sales: Quick sync — Acme's legal pushed back on domain ownership verification and SCIM creating users across multiple domains. They want a clear proof-of-control flow and an option to scope SCIM to a claimed domain.

alex_chen: We can do two pragmatic approaches: DNS TXT verification for domain claim, or SAML assertion (NameID/attribute) that ties a user to the org. Which would legal prefer?

maria_garcia: Legal also asked for org-level audit logs and guarantees about SCIM eventual consistency. They called out duplicates during initial syncs as a compliance risk. We don't currently publish a SCIM SLA.

devon: SCIM currently runs async workers — observed sync latency is ~30s-2min depending on backlog. We can expose `last_sync` + probed metrics in admin and add an `X-Redwood-SCIM-Request-ID` header for tracing. Example header we can include in responses:

```
X-Redwood-SCIM-Request-ID: scim-2026-0001-ab12
```

samira_security: Action items from security:
- Confirm SCIM payloads encrypted in transit and at rest (KMS).
- Confirm RBAC mapping supports Okta group -> role mapping and ability to disable auto-join.
- Confirm we have audit trails for admin role changes (immutable logs).

jordan_sales: Pricing question from them: if they take Dedicated capacity to isolate tenant, how does that change any per-provisioning or onboarding fees? Also will heavy SCIM churn affect unit costs?

alex_chen: Dedicated is a separate reserved contract. SCIM itself isn't billed per-user; cost impact is on throughput and reserved concurrency. For 100k users with frequent churn we typically recommend a reserved onboarding window + SRE support. I'll pull a rough quote from finance.

deploy-bot: env-bot: POC environment `acme-poc-2026` created in us-west2. Console: https://poc.redwood.example/acme-poc — SAML endpoint and SCIM base URL provisioned.

maria_garcia: For SAML we'll need their IdP metadata (entityID, sso URL, x509 cert). Minimal required attributes: `email`, `firstName`, `lastName`, `groups`. Please ask them to send the metadata xml.

devon: We support mapping SAML groups to internal roles. Example mapping snippet (YAML):

```
role_mappings:
  - idp_group: "acme-devops"
    role: "deployment_admin"
  - idp_group: "acme-engineering"
    role: "engineer"
```

jordan_sales: They also asked if SCIM supports attribute-level filtering (to avoid pulling users from other domains).

alex_chen: Yes — SCIM `filter` per RFC 7644 works. Example: `GET /Users?filter=emails.value sw \"@acme.com\"` — we can offer a preconfigured scoping rule on the tenant.

samira_security: Also verify we can rotate admin keys and enforce just-in-time elevation. They want a confirmation that there's no permanent super-admin cookie.

devon: We'll produce a runbook for account merge/dedupe and admin rotation. I'll attach the runbook and the SCIM latency dashboard to the POC doc.

jordan_sales: Outcome ask — if we can provide: DNS TXT verification sample + SAML metadata checklist + SCIM scoping example + security checklist + preliminary pricing by EOD Friday, customer will greenlight a live demo next week.

maria_garcia: :thumbsup: I'll draft the security checklist and mark the must-haves.

alex_chen: :+1: Devon — please post the SCIM metrics link and the runbook here when ready so I can bundle into the proposal.

devon: On it. Will post links and attach the runbook to the POC env by EOD tomorrow.

jordan_sales: tagging @samira_security and @alex_chen for tracking. Thanks everyone.
